title: NBN POI 4NER (Nerang) Cable Replacement Works
current_summary: Planned cable replacement at the Nerang (4NER) NBN Point of Interconnect was completed during the scheduled window between 11:00 PM and 6:00 AM AEST on 10–11 August. The work was performed by an upstream provider. NBN services delivered via the Nerang POI are operating normally and we will continue to monitor.

updates.content: Planned works at the Nerang NBN POI have been completed. The maintenance window ran from 11:00 PM AEST on 10 August to 6:00 AM AEST on 11 August. NBN services delivered via this POI are now operating normally. We will continue to monitor to ensure stability. Thank you for your patience.
